time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t*fps)
units: pixels (full 3840x2160 resolution, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
summary: Static close-up of a white tiled bathroom wall with a white wall-mounted toilet-roll holder (suction disc + horizontal rod). A right hand brings a white toilet roll in from the bottom-right corner, moves it up-left, then slides it leftwards onto the holder rod and stops at frame ~56; the hand still holds the roll at the end (no release).

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the upper-left wall area (never covered) vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.3 px in every frame (scripts/probe.py)
camera.view: roughly fronto-parallel to the wall; grout lines tilt ~0.3 deg and tile widths differ by ~5 % across the frame (mild perspective / lens), ignorable for the planar single-scale convention

objects.name: toilet_roll
objects.description: white toilet-paper roll with embossed flower pattern, seen from the side (cylinder axis horizontal, along the image x direction) once it is near the holder; held by the right hand at its right end
objects.visible_frames: 0-59 (frames 0-4 partly out of frame at bottom-right; right/lower part covered by fingers in all frames from 2)
objects.reference_point: center_x/center_y = mean of the 4 silhouette corners (visible centre of the side-view rectangle); NaN in frames 0-4 where the roll is cut by the frame edge (use TL corner or visible_bbox_center there)

size_px_clear_frames.length_along_axis_px: 589 +- 3 (frames 50-59, roll at rest, axis horizontal); 590-600 over frames 13-34
size_px_clear_frames.note: length = mean of top and bottom silhouette edge lengths (end face to end face), height = mean of left and right edge lengths (outer diameter)

objects.apparent_size_change: length and diameter constant within ~2 % over frames 9-59 -> no significant depth change in the side-view phase; frames 1-8 are a 3/4 view while the roll turns, so their 'length' is a projected value

objects.name: hand
objects.description: person's right hand (bare skin) entering from the right edge with a dark green sleeve on the forearm (sleeve visible at right edge from ~frame 30); holds the roll by its right end, thumb on the roll face
objects.visible_frames: 2-59 (always cut by the right/bottom frame edge)
objects.reference_point: centroid of the visible skin mask (truncated by the frame edge, so biased right/down); leftmost_x = fingertip/thumb tip extreme

objects.name: toilet_roll_holder
objects.description: white plastic holder on the wall: round suction disc with oval knob at upper-left, bracket going down, horizontal rod pointing right with a small upward end post at its free (right) end
objects.visible_frames: 0-59 (rod and lower bracket progressively hidden behind the roll from ~frame 20; disc stays visible)

objects.name: wall_tiles
objects.description: large white rectangular wall tiles laid in a running-bond pattern with grey grout lines

measurements_frame0_px.note: middle tile row (y 687-1741) holds the holder; the roll ends up in front of the middle tile with its bottom edge ~10-20 px above the lower horizontal grout

objects.name: roll_shadow
objects.description: soft grey shadow of roll/hand on the wall (to the left/upper-left of the roll)
objects.note: not tracked; can make the roll's left edge look wider in a naive mask

events.event: roll already entering: blurred top-left corner visible at bottom-right (~3280, 2025)
fast up-left motion of the roll; roll turns from a 3/4 view (left end face with core hole visible, frames 1-8) to a side view (by ~frame 10); in-plane tilt of the axis falls from ~14 deg to ~6 deg
highest roll position (TL_y min ~949, centre_y min ~1321 at f17): vertical motion reverses from up to slightly down
roll's left end passes the free end (end post, x~2340) of the holder rod: start of sliding onto the rod (rod enters the roll core)
roll yaws slightly (right end face visible as a thin strip) and its axis tilts to ~-4 deg
roll drops ~35-45 px (TL_y 1021->1066 at the right, centre_y 1391->1414) and becomes level: core settles onto the rod
roll stops; at rest frames 56-59 (centre ~ (1911, 1411), left end x ~1615); hand still holding, no release in the clip

files.tracks/toilet_roll.csv: per-frame roll corners, centre, bbox, extents, tilt, occlusion, source
files.tracks/hand.csv: per-frame hand skin-mask centroid, bbox, extents
files.scripts/: all measurement scripts and intermediate JSON
